c9_d2_mark_index_selection_calibration.purpose: Qualify and normalize causal 15-minute mark/index history covering all September funding events plus prior-day warmup without opening October UTC mark/index data.

still_protected_channels: July gap channels unless separately contaminated
August channels before 2024-08-31 remain protected unless separately contaminated
October UTC trade/SPOT/L2/mark/index Confirmation channels 2024-10-01..14 remain protected
c9_guardrails: C9-D2 may open mark/index values only inside [2024-08-31T00:00:00Z, 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z).
C9-D2 must not request or admit any October UTC mark/index candle.
C9-D2 must not calculate returns, premium transitions, strategy direction, threshold, event window, signal or PnL.
October 2024 funding is already contaminated for C9 and remains nonpromotional.
October trade/SPOT/L2/mark/index channels remain separately protected.
selection_rule: Anything inspected for feature choice, parameter choice, candidate selection, sentinel design/outcome, variance estimation or MDE planning is nonpromotional for the resulting implementation.
